title: Vintage Le Creuset Enameled Cast Iron Terrine No. 32
description:
Lovely vintage Le Creuset terrine made from enameled cast iron, both practical and timeless. Ideal for preparing foie gras, pâté, cakes, or other homemade dishes, with excellent heat retention for even cooking.
Authentic Le Creuset quality
Size: No. 32
Durable enameled cast iron
Great heat distribution for consistent results
Versatile use: foie gras, pâté, cakes, and more
This is a vintage item and shows signs of use, including some chips on the edge. Please refer carefully to the photos, as they are part of the description and show the exact condition.
